Often the owner feels that “something is wrong”: there is revenue, but the profit is disappearing; The command seems to be working, but there is no result. The reason is blurry.
Without a diagnosis, any treatment is guesswork. You can change people, introduce new tools, but if the root of the problem is not found, the symptoms will return.
